content: Gamaji ere wala-walawou langa mebodu woga.

Tere baabo gane, ji tere benou isi dewagu ganga boni gau hina, Moses nomo saini langa, ebere asage gane oruwa nere agau Itou no nere jala abitimu nigei nomo bona tafainga inyai waha nomo huuna langa yafaneha. Onodu bode, nere oruwanga golodu mai hiiri Giriwou fawaneha.
Onodu nere oruwanga agau langa hiiri langa yaage bisou toufe waneha, ono wanenga yaage bisou waha no nere Moses nomo fai‑aita bagu yafei nomo hangada nigaiha.
Ono wainga nere oruwanga Itou nomo Hauri da nigai waha nyaneha.
Ono bode nere oruwanga Itou nomo Hauri yaage nigai waha nyaneha. Yo, nere Hauri no gaara golowane waha nomo megebu yaage waha nyaneha. Megebu waha Kristus nogo.

Onou wa Itou no fai-aita bagu waha nebere gane baingaro nebere onowou bona gau tuwei uwa. Onou waha bona nere ha kara ewe langa umeru wanenga nebere genege gala haumu waha langa kejiwe onou jiri wane.
Onodu dada waha oruwanga agotete dorofe heigane, ere waha uredu boya ere dada inyaba waha boya agege adai warona, nere amina ono wane dorofe.
Tere yaawa itou unyinege adai isouwagu, nere nebereha ila ono wane dorofe. Itou nomo buk no benou lena, “Nere yafadu da nyidu bode yaage nyane, iinga nere fai goidu bode aita hanige manege asaneha.”
Ere longi fanyimu adai onowoya, nere nebereha ila onou onodu bode, fati etenga langa 23,000 yaae wane dorofe.
Onodu ere Kristus fere ada wala-wala tuwei nomo, nere nebereha ila ono wane dorofe, onodu maangi inyaba maasi niganenga inyaba wane.
Onodu tere Itou honggoro beele adai letuwagu, nere nebereha ila ono wane dorofe, ono wanenga fai dunege kotegou ensel medu bona dunege kote wainga umeru wane.

Dada beha agotete dorofe fai ila urei nomo bona nere langa heigai. Fai nere oula beha usuwei nomo saini juguna waha, ere fai elebe saini beha langa yafaya waha, isou higei nomo aasa beha Itou nomo buk langa yeregane.
Onou waha bona fai ete no ninau isona, no danga bagu otona wonga, wa no ure dewou. Gamaji no mebodu woga.

Wala-walawou tere langa heigai waha, wa wala-walawou hogo fere ete uwa. Wa wala-walawou fai oruwanga la heige-heigena dorofenga. Onodu Itou no nomo beele oojo-oojona, onou waha bona Itou no wala‑walawou waha ete‑te ada awa tuwonga, tere tebere danga feiya tuwonbona. Uwa. Wala-walawou tere langa heigei mata wonga, Itou no tere hoyo tigei nomo jala buru tagonbona. Jala waha benou. No tere ono tigonga danga bagu oto gadenga, wala-walawou waha tere ada ilei tigonbona.
Ere Itou unyi isou boya nere hauri inyaba fere unyinege adai isou woya.
Onou waha bona, tere yame ilibafe gane tigini, tere yaawa itou unyinege isouwei nomo fanyimu baae tudu yafagu.
Tere isou bagu waha boni, ji tere letigini. Tere tagewe yame beele haawe wagu.

Kap waha no Itou nomo figiniwou bagu, saini ere kap waha langa nyi boya, ere Itou hilobainga tu‑tuya, no ere Yesus Kristus nomo ganemu bagu fadamu higi-higina. Onodu beret waha lalatidu boya, saini ere beret waha nyi geyenga, no ere Kristus nomo gogala bagu fadamu higi‑higina.
Beret etenga wahanga, ere fai oruwanga beret etenga wahanga nyi-nyiya, onou waha bona ere fai-aita baingaro ere geege gala etenga yafaya.
Tere Israel nebere onowou bonade ninatege isagu. Saini nere kaafa alta ouwe langa biti ganenga nyide waha, nere alta waha nomo Itou bagu fadamu nigi-nigina.
Tere ji beele leni beha gamaji tere benou isagu ganga, nere haiden yaawa itou eeya muru wari nagi-nagide waha dada tigini iwagu ganga. Onodu ji yaawa itou nere dada tigini iwou lewei uwa.
Uwa. Ji benou leni. Dada haiden nere eeya muru waride waha, “nere hauri inyaba eeya muru wari nagide. Nere Itou eeya muru wari fuwegu uwa.” Onodu tere hauri inyaba bagu komowei nomo ji awani.

Tere Anyakaro nomo kap langa nyi bonade ege hauri inyaba nebere kap langa fere inyei nomo edo uwa. Onodu tere Anyakaro nomo tewol langa da nyi bonade ege hauri inyaba nebere tewol langa fere nyei nomo edo uwa.
Ere Anyakaro ono tuwedenga ere bona huwanya inyaba wonga honggorowei nomo onoya rute? Ere ebere danga no nomo danga feiya tuwou yo?
Ere gai-gai Itou unyi isouwei nomo.

“Ere dada oruwanga onowei nomo edo,” onou wa nere dada oruwanga ere yafa dewei nomo ada hoyo higi-higide. “Dada oruwanga ere onowei nomo edo,” onou wa nere dada oruwanga ere ono higi ganenga Kristen danga bagu ada heige-heigeya.
Ere hage hoyo higei nomo ninage adai isei nomo. Uwa. Ere ila hoyo nigei nomo ninage isoboya.
Nere kaafa muja dada maket langa huurude waha, tere dabu nyagu. Tere waha bonade ninatege baingaro isi bonade adai isoki wagu. Uwa.
Ere alai,

Onodu fere, fai ete no Yesus bona huwanya ngalengawei uwa waha, tere no ngate da nyei nomo isoki tigei mata wonga, tere no ngate goi bonade wonga, wa edo. Tere dada oruwanga tigaha waha tere dabu nyeinga nyagu. Tere ninatege baingaro isi bonade adai isoki wagu.

Onou wa fai ete no yafa bona benou letigei mata wonga, “Kaafa muja beha nere yaawa Itou eeya muru wari nagane waha,” Ono wonga, tere fai no letigaha waha bonade ninatege isidu, tere da waha adai nyagu. Gamaji tere nyabulu wagu ganga.

Ji tere tage nyabulu wagu ganga boni lewei uwa. Ji fai ete no tere nyabuluya waha isi tigoga boni leni. Onou wa fai ete no beele onouha lewei uwa wonga, ji taate dada gauni waha ji edo nyonboni. Ji taate boni fai ete nomo ninau oojo boni dada no sesena waha onowoni?
Ji Itou hilobainga tudu boni nyei mata woni wa, fai ete no taate bona ji dada Itou hilobainga tudu boni ononaha waha bona beele inyaba lehiyon bona?
Onou waha bona tere da nyi bonade, yaage nyagu yo, tere dada ila onoya, tere dada waha oruwanga tere Itou unyi anyakaro tuwei nomo bonade ono wagu.
Tere Juda bagu nere Grik bagu nere Itou nomo sios nomo fai-aita bagu bonade ninatege isidu, onowou hogo fere-fere nere ono nigonga une langa orososowei nomo edo waha adai ono wagu.

Ji fere, ji dada oruwanga ononi waha, nere fai oruwanga onowou oruwanga ji ononi waha edo gau nigona langa ono-ononi. Ji yage hoyo hiyei nomo boni haruwe ada teteni. Ji fai-aita ila Itou no ege gidu hanigonbona waha, hoyo nigei nomo boni haruwe teteni.
